title: CANAROCK lightweight pre-finished insulated panel
jurisdiction: Canada — national CCMC product evaluation; comparative attachment only, not a Calgary/Edmonton or Alberta project application

facts.text: The CCMC describes the product as a prefabricated, horizontally installed, non-loadbearing EIFS-type cladding panel with modular EPS cores, a drainage-cavity design and factory-applied coating/mesh.
The NBC 2015 opinion classifies several cladding and drainage-related provisions as Alternative and ties its opinion to stated conditions.
The limitations require fire blocks and protection of foam plastic and reference the specific evaluated construction and listing details.
facts.locator: CCMC 14088-R PDF, p. 14, Conditions and limitations

limitations: The report’s performance is limited to its stated system and installation conditions.
This panel assessment is not a project-specific code or fire-safety determination.
